description: test.yml's Julia is not an independent dependency: it runs the downloaded sysimage through the shim, and a sysimage links against libjulia.<major>.<minor>, so this must track the Julia that built the asset in ultimatile/jetls-sysimage. Patch releases are interchangeable, minor releases are not.

Renovate's built-in julia-actions/setup-julia rule sets no extractVersion, so the raw tag (`v1.13.0`) would land here and pin a patch level that setup-julia resolves at run time. Capturing major.minor keeps this in step with the sysimage side, which is also specified as major.minor.
The trailing `\.\d+$` is what excludes prereleases: `v1.13.0-rc4` must not match, or it would be rewritten to a stable-looking `1.13` (non-matching releases are dropped, not passed through).
